notes: Conversation understanding 2.0.12 / Build 25: 351 non-live unit tests and the unsigned Release build passed. Mocked store regressions cover a text-only topic over an unrelated older reading, retry across relaunch, returning to an older reading, rejecting a foreign conversation reference, changing participants, and blocking an unrelated person from a resolved question. Final DeepSeek and Qwen planner checks passed all six synthetic cases for period, topic, and participant references. The store tests verify that a planner intake suggestion for a verified continuation does not open the form.

Natural reading voice 2.0.11 / Build 24: 29 AI service tests passed. DeepSeek and Qwen each returned eight Chinese samples across the four voices and both reply routes. None of the 16 samples used the discouraged betting or theatrical openings. All four Deadpan samples opened with a direct answer, and one DeepSeek initial reading used four sentences. The signed Release build was installed and version-checked on the physical iPhone.

Reading voices 2.0.10 / Build 23: 46 focused non-live tests passed, including the request format and four voice settings for both providers. Two iPad simulator UI tests passed for the default fallback and selection persistence. Two live tests on the iPhone simulator returned 16 synthetic samples across DeepSeek and Qwen, covering all four voices in both synthesis and follow-up. Manual review found direct openings and distinct styles, with 15 replies of two or three sentences and one five-sentence Qwen follow-up. The signed Release build was installed and version-checked on the physical iPhone.

Interruptible analysis 2.0.9 / Build 22: 345 non-live unit tests and six chat progress UI tests passed on the iOS 26.5 iPhone 17 Pro simulator (Xcode 27.2). Nine opt-in live API tests were skipped. The UI verified completing an answer in the background, sending a follow-up during output, and retrying after termination and relaunch. The unsigned Release build passed. The iOS 26 continued-processing grant was not tested on a physical device.

Saved-profile reuse update 0.1.6 / Build 7: 219 non-live unit tests and five UI regressions passed; three opt-in live tests skipped. Existing named profiles retain UUID, birthday, wall-clock time, confirmed birth timezone and location. Empty AI participant arrays and missing name selections cannot hide grounded saved records; a sole saved person is only a visible form candidate, without automatic self binding. Incomplete non-declared-unknown draft fields are repaired from the matching saved UUID while intentional known edits and explicit unknowns remain. Birth timezone restoration preserves the local clock. Synthetic saved-profile → unqualified fortune question → prefilled form → one confirmation → coins/result, timezone selection, multi-person and followup flows verified. Final Debug tests and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings; live DeepSeek/physical GPS were not rerun. Other broader UI evidence below retains its earlier version.

Unified intake update 0.1.5 / Build 6: 205 non-live unit tests and 13 UI regressions passed; three opt-in live tests skipped. New readings open one complete form with all selected people inline and any requested numbers; one successful submit directly starts the reading or required card/coin operation. Missing required data stays in the same form with combined feedback. Searchable Chinese timezone selection, independent birth/current location, saved birthdays, draft recovery, stale callbacks, history, tarot/coin continuity, multi-person inputs and ordinary follow-ups verified. Final Debug builds and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings. Live DeepSeek/physical GPS were not rerun; older evidence below retains its original version.

Continuation and birth-location update 0.1.4 / Build 5: 194 non-live unit tests and five UI regressions passed; three opt-in live tests skipped. Detail follow-ups preserve the saved lines/cards, inputs, results and reading reference across relaunch; explicit recasts still require confirmation and fresh interactions. Birth/current location fields stay independent and preserve the resolved location timezone. Location UI uses a deterministic Debug fixture; physical GPS and live DeepSeek were not rerun. Final Debug builds and unsigned Release archive completed with zero warnings; older evidence below retains its original version.

Reading deletion update 0.1.3 / Build 4: 171 non-live unit tests and two deletion UI tests passed; three opt-in live tests skipped. Recent and all-record trash controls, explicit Cancel/Delete alert, relaunch persistence, UUID isolation, current/archived link cleanup, and cancellation without resurrection verified. Release archive completed with zero warnings; other UI/live results below are retained earlier evidence.

Versioning update: version 0.1.2 / Build 3 verified in Debug build settings and the unsigned Release archive, with the same app name and bundle ID. Four isolated version-guard tests plus nine credential-script tests passed. Earlier functional/UI/live result paths are retained evidence from 0.1.1 / Build 2, not newly rerun suites.

Branding-only update: supplied artwork installed as opaque 1024px app icon and matching avatar; display name, in-app identity and export title use 瞎子. Debug and Release product bundle identifiers remain com.lihao.BlindOracle. One UI regression and Release archive passed with zero warnings; the last full unit suite and broader interaction results below are retained evidence.
Release measured from the stripped unsigned arm64 archive .app, not App Store compressed download size.
163 non-live unit tests passed in the final run; three opt-in live tests were skipped there.

Six distinct UI regressions passed in complete result bundles: collapsed/expanded native loading indicator, history restoration, chat numbers followed by coin casts, two-person conversational intake and confirmed reading, flat profile fields, and preserving a saved birthday/time across editing and restart.
The native running indicator is outside the task-title Button label and transition. Captures 0.4 seconds apart changed 289 pixels in its indicator region while the task title remained fixed.

The separate live Pro/max test passed collect two named people, supplement birth facts, plan both participants, and stream a Chinese synthesis. Four remote requests with synthetic data only; no credential logged.

New readings collect scoped fields in chat, preserve the original question, and show a frozen information summary. An explicit user confirmation is required; changed profile data causes a fresh summary instead of overwriting the edit or starting a reading.

16 conversational intake tests and 16 preparation-policy tests cover strict required methods, mixed-method omissions, explicit unknowns versus blank defaults, AM/PM clarification, Chinese clock answers, self/other ownership, chat numbers, and recovery.

Unavailable methods cannot contribute to interpretation. Mixed readings retain per-person omission reasons and append a deterministic explanation at the end. Strict user-mandated methods remain blocked until required data is available.

Profile editing displays every field directly. Name-only edits preserve the original birth instant and wall-clock text. Default blank fields do not become declarations that the user does not know the answer.

Final Debug tests and unsigned Release archive completed with zero compiler/build warnings. Archive iPad orientations and absence of development credentials were checked directly; no store upload was performed.
Earlier offline tarot deck, keyboard, broader interaction, and history regression evidence remains at the retained paths. No reasoning_content is decoded, displayed, or persisted.

Changing the requested method while supplying data preserves the original question, applies the new method, and requires a new summary confirmation. A clock correction alone cannot change methods; ambiguous questions or negative replies cannot act as confirmation.

fixes.streaming: Incremental Unicode-scalar JSON decoder preserves combining marks, emoji, escaped surrogate pairs, and selects only the top-level text property.
fixes.history: A malformed conversation does not hide valid chats; recovery backups are deduplicated within the vault instance and fallback writes are blocked if preservation fails.
fixes.lifecycle: Persist before interpretation and on scene background; retain checkpointed partial replies and cancel stale progress in both messages and runs after restart.
fixes.location: Each request has its own CLLocationManager; old coordinate, authorization and error callbacks are rejected after cancellation or replacement.

ui_flows: Unified form submission proceeds to six coin casts and local results.
Birth location shortcut preserves independent current location and survives relaunch.
Follow-up reuses the saved reading across relaunch without new intake.
Background checkpoint survives process termination and relaunch without a running spinner or empty reply.
remaining_limits: Only the text received by the background checkpoint is durable until the request finishes; later unsaved chunks can be lost if the process is terminated.
JSON files are individually atomic; cross-file transactions and incremental conversation persistence remain planned work.
Minimum-supported-OS and physical-device background-termination checks were not run in this batch.

changes: Answer the current question in the first sentence; give a clear leaning when saved results support a distinction.
Explain the judgment with one or two specific available clues; do not force chart evidence into pure terminology or ordinary conversation.
Replace generic reassurance and repeated hedges with the main obstacle, advantage, action and relevant conditions.
Keep material limitations scoped to the affected question; clearly state what cannot be judged rather than inventing certainty.
Use substantive conflict-option titles and distinguishable conditions; preserve real disagreement.
Usually target 250 to 400 Chinese characters for initial synthesis; short answers may be shorter and follow-ups answer only what was asked.
